# The NetTest kit

The files of this directory are the kit of the NetTest specification `nettest/1`, copied unchanged from
`docs/wrapper-guide/nettest/` of the dxFeed Graal Native SDK sources, tag `v3.18.0`:
<https://github.com/dxFeed/dxfeed-graal-native-sdk/tree/v3.18.0/docs/wrapper-guide/nettest>.
The specification itself is
<https://github.com/dxFeed/dxfeed-graal-native-sdk/blob/v3.18.0/docs/wrapper-guide/nettest.md>.

Copyright (c) Devexperts LLC. The files are licensed under the Mozilla Public License 2.0, as the SDK sources:
<https://github.com/dxFeed/dxfeed-graal-native-sdk/blob/v3.18.0/LICENSE>.

The tests of `internal/nettest` and `cmd/tools` read them. To update the kit, copy the files of a newer tag and change
the tag above.
